Name: Bathroom Furniture for Content Patcher
Author: farmerbeans
Description:
[size=5][b]Bathroom Furniture for Content Patcher
[/b][/size][size=3]Decorate to your heart's content with bathroom furniture, wallpaper and flooring. Adds over 100 unique decor items.[/size]

[size=5][b]How to Use
[/b][/size][size=4][b]﻿
Version 1.0[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]The new items will show up in the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Furniture_Catalogue]Furniture catalog[/url] and Wallpaper/floor [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Catalogue]Catalog[/url] that you purchase from Robin/Pierre respectfully. [/size]
[/list][b]
﻿Version 2.0[/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Optional Bathroom Furniture Catalog, available at Robin's (Requires Calcifer mod)[/size]
[*]Customizable  catalogue price, defaults to 100,000g
[*]If the custom catalog is not active, bathroom furniture will be available in the Vanilla catalogs. 
[/list][size=3]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/thumbnails/26354/26354-1722647472-604098622.png[/img]﻿
[/size]
[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3]Content Patcher
Calcifer (as of v2.0)

[/size][size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Adds 100+ new furniture items, including toilets, showers, bathtubs, sinks, bathmats, towels and rubber duckies[/size]
[*][size=3]Original pixel-art by FarmerBeans. Some elements are based off of vanilla game sprites by ConcernedApe :)[/size]
[/list]
